headline: OpenAI's gpt-6-luna sets an all-time record at 8.3%, and OpenAI jumps 5.6 points in a day
summary: OpenAI had the loudest day on the board. gpt-6-luna hit an all-time token-share high of 8.3%, and OpenAI as a provider climbed 5.6 points in a single day to 14.4%. DeepSeek still sits on top at 34.5%, and the top two providers together hold 49.0%.
highlights: gpt-6-luna is on day 1 of its all-time record and has climbed four spots to #2 in one day.
gpt-6.1-sol also posted an all-time high at 3.4%, moving up four spots to #9.
DeepSeek and OpenAI together hold 49.0% of tokens, with DeepSeek alone at 34.5%.
Two newcomers arrived: Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1.2 debuts at #48 and thinkingmachines' inkling at #51.
Upstage's solar-pro4 (last at #47) and Anthropic's claude-fable-5.1 (last at #50) dropped off the board.
